BiblicalUsage: ʻuggâh is the Bible's word for a cake baked on the hearth, an ash-cake. In Genesis 18:6, make cakes upon the hearth, and it appears again in Exodus 12:39.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the cakes Sarah baked and the dough Israel carried show me God feeds His people in a hurry and at home.
